cycle_machine_common.edge_semantics: At the start of each local cycle sample the frozen input/response/sink-ready transcript and the entire prior state. Evaluate guards in ascending priority. Execute exactly one winning action, apply all listed state deltas atomically at the edge, increment exactly one primary cycle class, and perform no lower-priority action. No free FSM edge exists.

priority_table.action: FAULT_DRAIN: reject new source/frontier/bundle; retire already accepted work in external-owner, response-identity, pending-write, active-service, context phase/index order; mismatched work gets zero credit
HOLD_FINAL_OUTPUT: command/address/beat/data and every internal read/request/accept/retire/clear/cursor/owner/architecture delta are zero; only final_output_sink_stall_cycles increments

priority_table.guard: shared external/output/directory FSM has an enabled mandatory next microedge
priority_table.action: Execute exactly that imported FSM microedge; if blocked hold all payload and charge its named link/latency/port stall; no source, frontier, context or group action

priority_table.guard: one or more exact-L4 M218 responses mature or a psum pending write is due
priority_table.action: Retire the lowest tuple (due_cycle,phase,row,generation,O8_slot); same-edge Acc24 update and charged psum write are allowed; conflicting issue is forbidden
priority_table.primary_class: productive_source_or_group_issue or psum_1RW_conflict as determined by response validity

priority_table.action: Execute the unique group microstep in service_microsequence; if the next slice cannot issue, hold service state and charge the first blocking class in weight-L4,O8,psum-1RW,pending-RAW order

priority_table.guard: an architecture-specific transition guard is true
priority_table.action: Execute the first true row of that architecture transition table; no common input or other architecture transition occurs

priority_table.guard: canonical frontier token is offered and all matching ordinal descriptors retired
priority_table.action: Accept exactly one frontier token, update only the matching block-qualified owner and mark newly closable resident/context identities; mismatch faults with zero close/commit credit

priority_table.guard: canonical source/bundle token is offered and the selected architecture input predicate is true
priority_table.action: Accept exactly one whole bundle into charged ingress; partial-lane accept and same-edge group/context work are forbidden

priority_table.guard: block or time close predicate is true
priority_table.action: Execute one explicit block/time transition or directory-clear edge; no next-block bundle/frontier accepts on the same edge

No state delta except total_cycles and the unique fail-closed stall counter source_scan_frontier_stall; if this state should have progressed under a defined legal transcript, record transition_undefined_mismatch and fail

cycle_machine_common.input_priority_note: Architecture row ACCEPT_BUNDLE appears only when no already-offered frontier is pending. The canonical transcript never offers the next bundle until the prior ordinal frontier handshakes; therefore priorities 5 through 8 are total, not scheduler choices.
cycle_machine_common.cycle_conservation: total_cycles equals the integer sum of all mutually exclusive primary class counters

service_microsequence.context_round_constructor: Choose the lowest live contributor slot. Its cin_tile=floor(source_channel/16) freezes this round tile. Scan source bank 0..7 and select the lowest live slot in that bank with this cin_tile. Thus each round has one tile and at most one contributor per weight bank. Remove no slot until all six slice responses retire.
service_microsequence.SC8_round_constructor: Choose the lowest remaining ingress lane; freeze its cin_tile. Scan remaining lanes in stable lane order and greedily select a lane iff cin_tile matches, its weight bank is unused and its phase bank is unused. This permits at most one psum destination per phase and one source per weight bank in the round.
service_microsequence.ISO8_round_constructor: Head fixes destination, epoch and cin_tile. Add only the immediately adjacent valid lane iff full destination/epoch and cin_tile match and its weight bank differs; otherwise the group is the head singleton.
service_microsequence.lock_cycle: GROUP_LOCK is a charged cycle that freezes ordered contributors, their destination identities, active phases, tile, round index and slices_pending=0x3f. It issues no SRAM request.
service_microsequence.slice_issue: For lowest pending slice, issue in one cycle all active weight-bank reads and all distinct active phase psum reads. The request occupies one O8 entry and returns exactly four cycles later. A phase/tile/RAW/O8 conflict stalls with zero request side effect.
service_microsequence.slice_retire: At exact due cycle verify response identity, compute signed INT8 products with source_sign_bit=0, apply Acc24 wrap after each frozen contributor-order addition, and perform charged writes to every active phase. Clear that slice only on successful write retirement.
service_microsequence.rmw_count: Each selected destination in every bank round performs exactly six charged psum reads and six charged psum writes; partial groups do not create phantom product reads but pay the same six issue/response positions.
service_microsequence.completion: After slice5 retires, clear only the selected contributor slots and service lock. If a context still has live slots, no release_pending is set and its next bank round can lock no earlier than the following cycle. Only when its live-slot count becomes zero may context release_pending be set. Context release or bundle retirement never shares the slice5 edge.

A1-SC8.definition: Source-centric exact K8 over one frozen atomic M523 bundle; no destination-keyed lookahead or cross-bundle join.
A1-SC8.input_accept_predicate: sticky_fault==0 && ingress empty && no active_service && prior bundle_retire completed; all valid lanes share legal bundle identity and the entire payload fits all eight charged entries

ordered_rows.guard: ingress has remaining lanes && no active_service
ordered_rows.action: Construct the unique SC8 round from the lowest remaining lane and execute GROUP_LOCK; the constructed round is immediately serviceable even when it has 1..7 lanes
ordered_rows.state_delta: active_service set; ingress unchanged until successful slice5 retirement

ordered_rows.guard: ingress accepted_count>0 && ingress remaining_count==0 && no active_service && no canonical frontier token is offered
ordered_rows.state_delta: clear ingress epoch; increment SC8 bundle retirement; next bundle not accepted this edge

A1-SC8.partial_or_tail_flush: Always at completion of the stable greedy scan of the current remaining bundle lanes; no wait for adjacent descriptor, event boundary, frontier, next bundle or stream tail is legal.

A1-ISO8.definition: Exact current-head/immediately-adjacent merge only; no deeper search, reorder, cross-bundle or cross-event waiting.
A1-ISO8.input_accept_predicate: sticky_fault==0 && ingress empty && no active_service && prior bundle_retire completed; all valid lanes share legal bundle identity and the entire payload fits all eight charged entries

ordered_rows.guard: ingress has a valid head && no active_service
ordered_rows.action: Inspect exactly head and the next stable valid lane; construct ISO8 singleton or exact adjacent pair using ISO8_round_constructor and execute GROUP_LOCK
ordered_rows.state_delta: selected lane identities frozen; ingress lanes clear only after successful slice5 retirement

ordered_rows.guard: ingress accepted_count>0 && ingress remaining_count==0 && no active_service && no canonical frontier token is offered
ordered_rows.state_delta: clear ingress epoch; next bundle not accepted this edge

A1-ISO8.partial_or_tail_flush: Immediate after the one adjacent-lane inspection. Head singleton flushes even if more non-adjacent matching descriptors may arrive; bundle/event/frontier/stream tail cannot extend it.

A1-OSG.definition: Same-resource output-stationary mini-batch Gustavson with the exact sixteen-context window and no architecture-specific lookahead.
A1-OSG.input_accept_predicate: sticky_fault==0 && ingress empty && no active_service && no FULL/CLOSE/BLOCK_DRAIN context is serviceable; nonfull nonclose contexts may persist; all valid lanes share legal bundle identity and the entire payload fits all eight charged entries

serviceable_predicate.PRESSURE: the lowest valid ingress lane cannot move because its matching context is full or its phase has no free context; victim is matching full context else lowest context index in that phase
serviceable_predicate.CLOSE: block-qualified frontier >= context.last_possible_source_ordinal and no matching ingress/O8/pending-write/external work
serviceable_predicate.BLOCK_DRAIN: canonical current-block source transcript ended and no later descriptor can enter this context
serviceable_predicate.serviceable: required && (FULL || selected PRESSURE victim || CLOSE || BLOCK_DRAIN)

ordered_rows.guard: lowest ingress lane has a matching context with slot_count<8
ordered_rows.action: Move exactly that lane into the next free slot of the matching context
ordered_rows.state_delta: clear ingress lane; increment context slot_count; no group lock this edge

ordered_rows.guard: lowest ingress lane has no match and its phase has a free context
ordered_rows.action: Allocate lowest free context index in that phase and move exactly that lane into slot0
ordered_rows.state_delta: set exact destination/epoch/last_possible identity and one slot; no service this edge

ordered_rows.guard: lowest ingress lane exists but cannot move
ordered_rows.action: Choose the unique PRESSURE victim and GROUP_LOCK its next context bank round

ordered_rows.guard: ingress empty and one or more FULL contexts exist
ingress empty and one or more CLOSE contexts exist
ingress empty and current block drain is active and a nonempty context exists
ingress accepted_count>0 && ingress remaining_count==0 && no FULL/CLOSE/drain service is required && no canonical frontier token is offered
ordered_rows.action: BUNDLE_RETIRE while retaining nonfull nonclose contexts
ordered_rows.state_delta: clear ingress epoch only; next bundle not accepted this edge

A1-OSG.service_completion_rule: The final slice5 edge marks release_pending. CONTEXT_RELEASE is a distinct following cycle and cannot move an ingress lane or allocate a replacement.
A1-OSG.partial_or_tail_flush: Only PRESSURE, CLOSE or BLOCK_DRAIN may flush 1..7 slots; FULL flushes exactly eight. Nonfull contexts may persist across bundles but never across output block or time.

PBR4.definition: Exact K3/S2 phase-banked single-atomic-bundle bounded rendezvous with four contexts per phase and exact partial-RMW backing.
PBR4.input_accept_predicate: sticky_fault==0 && ingress empty && all sixteen contexts empty && no active_service && no bundle_epoch_retire_pending; all valid lanes share legal tag/time/generation and the entire payload fits the eight charged entries

ordered_rows.guard: lowest valid ingress lane has a matching context with slot_count<8
ordered_rows.action: Move exactly that lane into the next free slot of the matching context
ordered_rows.state_delta: clear ingress lane; context slot_count increments; no service this edge

ordered_rows.guard: lowest valid ingress lane has no match and its phase has a free context
ordered_rows.action: Allocate lowest free index in that phase and move exactly that lane to slot0
ordered_rows.state_delta: set exact identity and one slot; no service this edge

ordered_rows.guard: lowest valid ingress lane exists but cannot move
ordered_rows.action: GROUP_LOCK the matching full context, else lowest valid context index in the lane phase
ordered_rows.state_delta: ingress unchanged; selected context service lock set

ordered_rows.guard: ingress empty && at least one nonempty context exists
ordered_rows.action: GROUP_LOCK lowest (phase,index) context, including every 1..7-slot tail

ordered_rows.guard: ingress empty && all contexts empty && no active_service && bundle_epoch_valid && no canonical frontier token is offered
ordered_rows.state_delta: clear epoch owner and set ready-for-next-bundle for the following cycle

PBR4.service_completion_rule: Final slice5 retirement clears selected slots. It sets context_release_pending iff no live slot remains; otherwise the next bank round must lock on a later cycle. A distinct CONTEXT_RELEASE edge clears an empty context; only a later cycle may move the blocked ingress lane into that index.
PBR4.tail_flush: Once ingress is empty, every nonempty context is serviceable in phase,index order regardless of fill. No context crosses the accepted bundle epoch.

context_release_normalization.rule: For A1-OSG and PBR4, a context enters release_pending only when slice5 retirement leaves its live-slot count equal to zero. Before any ordinary table row for that architecture, lowest (phase,index) release_pending wins and consumes one charged CONTEXT_RELEASE cycle. This row is implicit priority -1 in both tables and has no same-edge ingress move, allocation, group lock, bundle retirement or new accept.

golden_cycle_schedules.encoding: The canonical_json_utf8 byte string is hashed exactly as shown, with no trailing newline. These are minimal control-plane resident-hit/weight-hit/no-stall transcripts. The common six-slice service timing is literal: four consecutive issues, four due response retires, two issues, two charged L4 waits, two response retires.
golden_cycle_schedules.preconditions: one legal two-lane bundle; source_sign_bit=0; exact resident clean psum and resident weight tile; distinct weight banks; SC8 lanes have distinct phases, while ISO8/OSG/PBR4 lanes share one exact destination; ready always one; no external or directory work
golden_cycle_schedules.mismatch_policy: Any independent expansion that differs in length, label sequence, group identity, six-slice RMW sequence or SHA fails the contract before candidate visibility. Golden vectors are semantic regressions, not measured performance results.
